# Skool Video Downloader

The ultimate companion for Skool learners. Save your favorite lessons for offline archival.

## Core Capabilities
- Download videos from Skool classroom modules.
- Supports Skool native (Mux), Loom, Vimeo, and Wistia. YouTube is not supported.
- One-click MP4 extraction.
